purpose: Freeze SRC as a third-target test of the Stage45-authorized k=6 rank-sensitive receptor-ensemble hypothesis before structural discovery or docking outcomes are read.

evidence_timing.selection_basis: existing local DUD-E source availability, human noncovalent kinase compatibility, and expected public structural abundance; no SRC enrichment result

frozen_hypothesis.objective_source: Stage42f BACE1; applied without SRC-specific term or weight changes
frozen_hypothesis.selection_aggregation: minimum rank across selected receptors after per-seed receptor empirical-CDF normalization
frozen_hypothesis.primary_claim: A fixed k=6 QUBO-selected receptor ensemble improves robust BEDROC20 over the best single SRC receptor on scaffold-held-out development folds and on one untouched fresh-validation panel.

ligand_allocation.grouping: Bemis-Murcko scaffold joined with duplicate source IDs and canonical-SMILES duplicates before deterministic allocation
ligand_allocation.failure_action: Stop before docking if exact molecule-, canonical-SMILES-, source-ID-, and scaffold-disjoint allocation is infeasible.

structural_pool.metadata: wild-type human SRC kinase-domain X-ray structures, resolution at or below 3.0 A, ordinary noncovalent ATP-site ligand
structural_pool.coordinate_hard_gates: reference-alignable chain, complete anchor and pocket templates, no explicit covalent target-ligand bond, no required metal-mediated scoring chemistry
structural_pool.failure_action: Stop SRC before production docking if fewer than 32 structures pass label-independent coordinate hard gates.

cognate_redocking.failure_action: Stop before benchmark docking if fewer than 24 frozen receptors pass; do not add replacements after outcomes are known.

production.score_aggregation: median across seeds per receptor-ligand pair
production.fresh_validation_release_condition: all development support gates pass without SRC-specific retuning
production.locked_test_release_condition: fresh validation passes the same direction-of-effect gate

required_classical_comparators: beam-64 plus fixed-k swap local search
exact enumeration when state count is feasible

interpretation_boundary: Stage46 source intake and preregistration can establish SRC identity, source integrity, and a prospective third-target protocol. It cannot establish structural-pool adequacy, redocking success, enrichment improvement, QUBO superiority, quantum execution, quantum speedup, or quantum advantage.
